caption: The drawing, rendered in grayscale pencil on a beige background, depicts a single, vertically oriented object that appears to be a vessel or shaker with a lidded, perforated top. The main object is centered inside a rectangular frame drawn in fine lines. The vessel has a tall, cylindrical upper section with small diamond-shaped perforations and a finial at the top, leading down to a slightly flared neck. The body of the vessel is wider at the middle and tapers towards the base, which is round and sits on a stepped foot. There is a simple, engraved bird with a branch on the midsection of the vessel. In the lower right corner of the main frame is a small inset drawing showing a side profile of the vessel with internal dimensions marked. In the upper left corner, there is a stamp-like rectangular label containing the number "10380." The drawing is monochrome, using pencil shading to suggest form and volume, while the rest of the page remains blank without any color or background details. In the bottom left corner, the artist’s name “LESTER DUSTIN” is written in small capital letters.
title: Silver Pepper Pot
